keyLimits.en: Minimum 10 users. Core calling and texting, HubSpot/Pipedrive/Zoho integration, 1,000 AloAi voice analytics minutes, IVRs, call recording, bulk SMS/MMS.
Minimum 5 users. Adds HubSpot workflows, 5,000 AloAi minutes, Power Dialer, AI transcriptions/summaries/sentiment analysis, dedicated success manager, call coaching.
Minimum 5 users. Adds Salesforce integration, unlimited AloAi minutes, keyword detection, trending topics, white-glove onboarding, 99.99% SLA, managed 10DLC compliance.

addOns.en: AloAi Voice Agent (AI voice calling), starting at 10 cents/minute.
Local Presence add-on, $300/month; local and toll-free numbers, $4-6/month each; branded Caller ID, $0.09-0.12/call.

cautions.en: Every plan carries a minimum seat count (5 or 10 users), which raises the effective entry cost well above the headline per-seat price; the source page listed monthly and annual figures in a way that read as annual costing more than monthly, but the stated '15% savings' only reconciles if annual billing ($30/$60/$85 per user) is cheaper than monthly billing ($40/$70/$100 per user), so this dossier applies that correction and it should be reverified on the official page.

capabilities.en: Cloud call center with automated power dialer, SMS/MMS bulk messaging and IVR, aimed at sales and support teams.
AloAi voice AI features: call transcription, summaries, sentiment analysis, keyword and trending-topic detection on higher plans.
Native integrations with HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho and Salesforce (Salesforce on the top xPro plan only).

limitations.en: Every plan enforces a minimum seat count (5 or 10 users), making it unsuitable for solo users or very small teams.
Salesforce integration and unlimited AloAi minutes are reserved for the top xPro + AI plan.

reason.en: Cloud call center competitor with similar CRM integrations and per-seat pricing, without Aloware's minimum-seat requirement.
Sales dialer and calling platform targeting the same outbound sales use case.
Simpler cloud phone system alternative, better suited to solo users and very small teams that Aloware's seat minimums exclude.
Virtual call center platform competing on similar dialer and CRM-integration features.

unknowns: The pricing page's monthly vs. annual labeling was ambiguous (fetched text implied annual billing costs more per user than monthly, which contradicts its own '15% savings' claim); this dossier reassigned monthly=$40/$70/$100 and annual=$30/$60/$85 per user to match the stated discount, and it should be reverified directly against aloware.com/pricing.
